text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered: API-GW-502s (eu-west) — p50 errors 6.8% over 5m :rotating_light:
andrew.s: seeing spike across ingress-mux hosts, 502 and some 504 timeouts. Repro with curl:
```
curl -v https://api.eu-west.redwood.ai/v1/health
> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
maria: confirmed same from west cluster. errors show "upstream reset" in edge proxy logs.
oncall: @oncall taking the pager, joining call in 3m. what's customer impact?
cs-lead: CS: 4 paying customers reported request failures; one streaming product experienced partial failures. Tier-1 customers impacted :wave:
emma: metrics: request rate steady, error budget burn on hosted tier. KV-cache hit rate looks normal.
tarun: quick mitigation: enable regional fallback routing to us-east and reduce fanout to 3. can someone flip traffic routing?
andrew.s: I can flip mux fallback to us-east and limit fanout. pushing change now.
emma: also suggest increasing gateway upstream timeout from 30s->45s for a short window.
maria: logs show backend pool A has tcp resets, suspect node oom or NIC flaps. will check.
oncall: i'm starting traffic shift to 10% -> 50% -> 100%, monitoring.
andrew.s: applied policy: mux.fallback.region=us-east, fanout.max=3
oncall: shift 10% done :thumbsup:
emma: added temporary timeout patch in edge config, will roll 1/2 hosts then all.
maria: backend team says they're restarting pool A nodes now.
cs-lead: notified affected customers with brief message, using status.redwood.ai/incidents/4891234000
tarun: if errors persist after shift, plan B = enable degraded-mode where streaming uses short-poll fallback.
oncall: 50% shift complete, error rate falling to 2.1%
incident-bot: Incident INC-2024-502-4891234000 created, priority P1 — channel #incidents
andrew.s: good to see recovery, keep monitoring 30m then debrief.
cs-lead: prepping postmortem template and customer notes.
oncall: handing over to morning oncall @emma in 15m. leaving notes in #incidents.
emma: taking handoff, will keep watch and coordinate with backend restarts.
maria: follow-up: backend pool A had NIC driver bug, rolling kernel update scheduled for this afternoon.
tarun: added runbook entry for mux fallback steps.
incident-bot: PagerDuty resolved (acknowledged) — incident flagged for follow-up.
